thread:
maya: Quick sync — we need final acceptance gates for the next catalog onboard (cohort A). Main asks: clear perf thresholds, quality gate definition, pin/backoff policy, and migration runway that sales can communicate.
ash: high level: mini-canary -> 5 tenants, mixed traffic (hosted + dedicated), run for 72h. If metrics stable we open cohort.
kevin: for quality let's do a two-tier check: automated eval (LM-quality metrics + rerank AUC) + human spot checks on 100 prompts. Automated threshold: no more than 2% drop vs baseline on our eval_set_v2.
lia: perf SLOs proposal: hosted p95 < 350ms, p99 < 800ms; dedicated p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms. Token cost delta target: <= +15% vs baseline. If overshoot, we hold.
sam: migration runway idea: opt-in window (6 weeks) with telemetry + incentive credits, then soft forced swap for those who didn't opt-in (2-week notice), final rollback grace 30 days. Pins TTL default 90d but can request 180d for enterprise customers.
maya: pinback rules: customers can pin a model version, but we add a compatibility shim that auto-falls back to pinned version for critical API routes. Pin requests should include a rationale and testset showing parity.
julie-sales: need a short blurb for customers — can we commit to an opt-in period + credits? sales needs one-liner by EOD tomorrow.
ash: ops constraints: canary machines must be on Dedicated pool labeled "canary-A". Autoscale cap at 2x baseline to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
kevin: metrics we should capture during canary: latency p50/p95/p99, token-cost-per-request, output-quality-diff (eval_set_v2), hallucination-rate (simple heuristics), error-rate. We'll fail the gate on any regression beyond thresholds or a sustained error spike.
lia: monitoring hooks: add route-level breakdown in Console for canary tenants, and a Deployment tag so tracing can filter. We should also attach the eval artifacts (diff CSVs) to the rollout ticket.
maya: acceptance checklist (draft):
- automated eval pass (<=2% quality delta)
- human spot-check pass (>=85% thumbs-up on 100 samples)
- perf SLOs met for 72h window
- cost delta <= +15%
- no P1/P0 incidents
- rollforward plan (rollback and fallback verified)
ash: dev tasks: infra to provision canary pool + config. Also add feature flag: `catalog.canary.enable` with tenant whitelist.
kevin: sample config for the canary gate (for ops):
```
canary:
  tenants: 5
  duration_hours: 72
  metrics:
    latency_p99_ms: 800
    quality_max_delta_pct: 2
    cost_max_delta_pct: 15
  rollback_on: ["p1_incident", "quality_regression"]
```
sam: migration comms timeline suggestion: T-4w internal notif; T-3w customer opt-in opens; T-1w final warning; T+2w soft swap; T+8w final cutoff for non-enterprise.
maya: question for product: do we allow partial pin expiry (per-route TTL)? some customers want pin only for chat endpoints.
ash: technically doable — extend pin metadata with `routes: []` and `ttl_days`. Ops will want a migration script to reconcile pins after TTL expiry.
kevin: we should add an automated compatibility check before expiry: run customer sample prompts against target model and pinned model; if regression detected, auto-extend pin with a ticket for SE review.
julie-sales: good — that reduces customer risk. i'll draft the external-facing copy: "Opt-in migration with credits + 90-day pin grace. Compatibility checks run before pin expiry." send me by EOD.
deploy-bot: smoke results posted: canary-A nodes up, basic inference smoke (10k tokens) passed, p99 observed 620ms on hosted variant.
lia: noted. hosted p99 620ms is inside gate but close. recommend a second 24h observation period before greenlight.
maya: agree — let's hold open for extra 24h. Action items:
- ash: provision canary pool + feature flag (due: 2d)
- kevin: finalize eval automation + human sample plan (due: 3d)
- lia: dashboard hooks + trace filters (due: 2d)
- sam: migration comms timeline & pin policy doc (due: 3d)
- julie-sales: external blurb + sales FAQ (due: EOD tomorrow)
I'll collect drafts and we reconvene after the extra 24h observation. :thumbsup:
